profile.summary: A privately held, woman-owned consulting company based in Frankfort, Illinois. It designs, sets up and manages Salesforce Education Cloud systems, which are software tools for tracking relationships with students, families and alumni. Its clients are educational institutions in North America, including K-12 schools, colleges and universities.
